questions.name: Personal Protective Equipment
questions.objective: 7.1 Recognize the role and limitations of PPE in construction hazard control
questions.text: What is the main role of PPE in construction safety?

answers.text: To protect workers from hazards that remain after other controls are applied
To remove the need for hazard identification
To replace guardrails, ventilation, and safe work practices in every case
To make unsafe work acceptable without planning

explanations.a: PPE helps reduce exposure when hazards cannot be fully eliminated or controlled by other methods. This is the correct answer.
explanations.b: Hazards still must be identified before the correct protection can be selected.
explanations.c: PPE is important, but it should not automatically replace more effective controls.
explanations.d: Prevention focus: PPE does not remove the need for safe planning and hazard control.

questions.name: Personal Protective Equipment
questions.objective: 7.1 Recognize the role and limitations of PPE in construction hazard control
questions.text: Which statement best describes a limitation of PPE?

answers.text: PPE works even when damaged or worn incorrectly
PPE depends on correct selection, fit, condition, and use
PPE removes the need for worker training
PPE eliminates every construction hazard at the source

explanations.a: Damaged or misused PPE may provide little or no protection.
explanations.b: PPE protection can fail when it is poorly selected, damaged, improperly fitted, or not used correctly. This is the correct answer.
explanations.c: Workers need training so PPE is used correctly.
explanations.d: PPE does not eliminate the hazard; it helps protect the worker from exposure.

questions.name: Personal Protective Equipment
questions.objective: 7.1 Recognize the role and limitations of PPE in construction hazard control
questions.text: During PPE planning for a construction task, A task exposes workers to flying debris from cutting. What should the supervisor consider?

answers.text: Ignore debris if the task takes a short time
Use sunglasses as the main protection for all cutting tasks
Use guards or barriers where feasible and provide appropriate eye or face protection
Let nearby workers decide whether protection is comfortable

explanations.a: Short tasks can still cause serious eye or face injuries.
explanations.b: Ordinary sunglasses are not a substitute for task-appropriate eye protection.
explanations.c: PPE should be combined with other controls such as guards and barriers when flying debris is present. This is the correct answer.
explanations.d: Protection should be based on the hazard, not comfort alone.

questions.name: Personal Protective Equipment
questions.objective: 7.1 Recognize the role and limitations of PPE in construction hazard control
questions.text: Why is PPE considered a last line of defense?

answers.text: It is never useful on construction sites
It works without inspection or training
It should be used only after a worker is injured
It protects the worker but usually does not remove the hazard itself

explanations.a: PPE is often necessary and valuable when selected and used correctly.
explanations.b: Inspection and training are essential for reliable PPE performance.
explanations.c: Prevention focus: PPE should be provided before exposure to hazards.
explanations.d: PPE reduces exposure at the worker, while other controls may eliminate or isolate the hazard. This is the correct answer.

questions.name: Personal Protective Equipment
questions.objective: 7.2 Identify head, eye, face, hand, and foot protection practices
questions.keyword: head eye face hand and foot protection
questions.text: A supervisor is reviewing PPE requirements with a crew. Which PPE helps protect workers from falling or flying objects striking the head?

answers.text: A hard hat appropriate for the hazard
Dust mask
Soft cloth cap
Safety vest

explanations.a: Hard hats protect the head from certain impact and penetration hazards when properly selected and worn. This is the correct answer.
explanations.b: A dust mask does not protect the head from falling objects.
explanations.c: Construction context: a soft cap does not provide construction head impact protection.
explanations.d: High-visibility clothing helps visibility but does not protect the head from impact.

questions.name: Personal Protective Equipment
questions.objective: 7.2 Identify head, eye, face, hand, and foot protection practices
questions.keyword: head eye face hand and foot protection
questions.text: When is eye or face protection needed?

answers.text: Solely when the worker personally wants it
When workers are exposed to flying particles, chemical splash, sparks, or similar hazards
Solely after debris has already struck someone
Solely for office work inside the trailer

explanations.a: Prevention focus: PPE use should be based on hazard exposure, not personal preference.
explanations.b: Eye and face protection should match the task hazards such as impact, splash, or sparks. This is the correct answer.
explanations.c: Answer boundary: protection should be used before exposure.
explanations.d: Office work usually has different hazards than cutting, grinding, or chemical work.

questions.name: Personal Protective Equipment
questions.objective: 7.2 Identify head, eye, face, hand, and foot protection practices
questions.keyword: head eye face hand and foot protection
questions.text: Which glove choice is most appropriate?

answers.text: Loose gloves around rotating equipment
Chemical gloves selected without checking the chemical hazard
Gloves selected for the specific hazard such as cuts, chemicals, heat, or abrasion
Any glove available in the gang box

explanations.a: Loose gloves can be caught in moving parts.
explanations.b: Chemical resistance should be matched to the substance involved.
explanations.c: Hand protection must match the hazard because different glove materials protect against different exposures. This is the correct answer.
explanations.d: Random glove selection may not protect against the actual hazard.

questions.name: Personal Protective Equipment
questions.objective: 7.2 Identify head, eye, face, hand, and foot protection practices

questions.text: Which footwear practice helps reduce construction foot injuries?

answers.text: Use damaged protective footwear without review
Wear thin casual shoes in active material handling areas
Remove footwear traction when walking on wet surfaces
Use protective footwear suited to impact, puncture, slip, or electrical hazards

explanations.a: Damaged PPE may not provide reliable protection.
explanations.b: Construction context: casual shoes may not protect against impact or puncture hazards.
explanations.c: Traction helps reduce slips.
explanations.d: Foot protection should be selected for hazards such as falling materials, sharp objects, slippery surfaces, or electrical exposure. This is the correct answer.

questions.name: Personal Protective Equipment
questions.objective: 7.5 Recognize employer and worker responsibilities for PPE use and training
questions.text: On site, what is an employer responsibility related to PPE?

answers.text: On site, leave all PPE decisions to workers without hazard assessment
On site, provide PPE but never explain its limitations
On site, require damaged PPE to stay in use until the project ends
On site, assess hazards, provide required PPE, and train workers on proper use when needed

explanations.a: PPE decisions should be based on hazard assessment and requirements.
explanations.b: Workers need to know proper use, care, and limitations.
explanations.c: Damaged PPE should be removed from service.
explanations.d: Employers must ensure appropriate PPE is provided and workers understand how to use it. This is the correct answer.
